anticheat_flags_no_leecher_open_unique.name: anticheat_flags_no_leecher_open_unique
anticheat_flags_no_leecher_open_unique.where: kind = 'no_leecher' AND reviewed_at IS NULL AND torrent_id IS NOT NULL

bonus_grants_first_seeder_unique_idx.name: bonus_grants_first_seeder_unique_idx
bonus_grants_first_seeder_unique_idx.where: source = 'first_seeder' AND torrent_id IS NOT NULL

torrents_grouped_idx.name: torrents_grouped_idx
torrents_grouped_idx.where: "torrents"."moderation_status" = 'accepted' AND "torrents"."is_active" AND ("torrents"."tmdb_id" IS NOT NULL OR "torrents"."igdb_id" IS NOT NULL OR "torrents"."openlibrary_id" IS NOT NULL)

torrents_ungrouped_idx.name: torrents_ungrouped_idx
torrents_ungrouped_idx.where: "torrents"."moderation_status" = 'accepted' AND "torrents"."is_active" AND "torrents"."tmdb_id" IS NULL AND "torrents"."igdb_id" IS NULL AND "torrents"."openlibrary_id" IS NULL
